name: crm
description: General CRM archetype with people, organizations, activities, notes and usable search/list/detail workflows.
journeys: create contact -> enrich details -> add note/activity
attach file -> retrieve from contact history
guidelines: Optimize list/detail workflows for information density without becoming visually cramped.
Preserve an audit-like chronological activity view.
definition_of_done: Notes and activities persist and appear chronologically.
Forms include validation and usable empty/error states.
